author: SegmentLinking
body:
This is a technical PR (identical physics performance on CPU and within reproducibility on GPU) to drop a number of unnecessary columns in LST (either totally unused or replaced by a couple of operations on related columns). No timing regressions showed up in private tests.

The net gain from this update is that the memory requested by the LST SoAs is reduced by ~17% at no physics or timing cost.
title: LST memory reduction by dropping unnecessary columns
